verdict.rationale: Ultrametric documents an HTTP API reference (overview and operations pages), and the CLI prints the hosted API's input JSON Schemas, plus local record schemas with worked examples, without login. That gives a static, inspectable contract, but nothing in the evidence shows an interactive explorer or try-it console. The documented OpenAPI contract that could power one returns 404 on both hosts, and every hosted operation requires sign-in, so no example can be run against the API keylessly. Missing for 10: an interactive API explorer, runnable in-docs examples, a reachable OpenAPI contract, and independent corroboration. Ultrametric-affiliation governance, README §9.]
